title: REDFM: Filtered and Multilingual Relation Extraction
description: Multilingual relation extraction across 7 human-revised languages (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Spanish) derived from Wikidata. Annotators verify entity spans and label relations using Wikidata relation types. The larger automatically-annotated SREDFM dataset covers 18 languages and 400 relation types.
